TARGET.md.utf8:
# Target

Prove both Cassini identities for every integer $n\geq1$: $a_{n+1}a_{n-1}-a_n^2=(-1)^n$ for $a_0=0$, $a_1=1$, $a_{n+2}=2a_{n+1}+a_n$; and $b_{n+1}b_{n-1}-b_n^2=(-1)^n$ for $b_0=0$, $b_1=1$, $b_{n+2}=b_{n+1}+b_n$.
